key_point: GTA was a failing racing game until a police AI bug made being chased the fun part
title: Grand Theft Auto became what it is because of a bug in the police cars.
caption: Grand Theft Auto became what it is because of a bug in the police cars. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #gta #grandtheftauto #rockstargames

instagram.caption:
Grand Theft Auto became what it is because of a bug in the police cars.

It began in the mid-90s as a racing game called Race'n'Chase, and it was close to being cancelled. Then a glitch made the police ram the player instead of following.

Testers loved being hunted so much that the team rebuilt the whole game around the chase. The first GTA came out in 1997.
